programme.title: The Perfect Christmas Present
programme.desc: Tom Jacobs has built a business around helping clients find the perfect gift for their loved ones. When he's hired to find a gift for his friend's girlfriend, he finds himself in a bit of trouble: The more he researches her, the more he likes her.

programme.title: My Norwegian Holiday
programme.desc: A grieving woman forges a deep connection with a Norwegian man when he discovers she has a troll figurine from his hometown. She soon agrees to accompany him to Norway to uncover the troll's origins and find her own path to healing, love and family.

programme.title: Christmas Made to Order
programme.desc: When an architect finds himself hosting his family for Christmas, he turns to a holiday coordinator for help. Her expert Christmas spirit brings his family together, but neither expected it to bring them closer to each other.

programme.title: Take Me Back for Christmas
programme.desc: A Christmas wish grants Renée the successful life she's always dreamed of -- except she finds herself no longer married to her beloved husband.

programme.title: Deck the Walls
programme.desc: Interior designer, Rose DeMonte, uses her skills back in her hometown to renovate a Christmas Charity Home for her brother Sal and his contractor Brysen's home flipping company.

programme.title: Three Wisest Men
programme.desc: As life pushes their family in different directions, the Brenner boys decide they need to put on the best Christmas ever to bring everyone back together.

programme.title: Once Upon a Holiday
programme.desc: When a royal princess runs away from her official obligations and duties, she starts to fall in love with a good Samaritan who is unaware of her real identity.

programme.title: Miracle in Bethlehem, PA
programme.desc: A single woman with a newly adopted baby gets stuck in Bethlehem, Pa. With no room at the inn, she's forced to stay with a stranger who turns out to be the miracle she has needed.

programme.title: The More the Merrier
programme.desc: Sparks fly between an emergency room doctor and a cardiologist as they work together to deliver three babies just in time for Christmas.

programme.title: Believe in Christmas
programme.desc: With no other plans for Christmas, best friends Bea and Emilia travel to Christmasland, a magical place filled with hope, holiday miracles and romance.

programme.title: Sealed With a List
programme.desc: This holiday season, festive Carley sets out to conquer her list of abandoned resolutions from last year. Aided by co-worker Wyatt, she finds love and the confidence to chase her dreams.

programme.title: Christmas at the Golden Dragon
programme.desc: When Romy and Rick's parents surprise them with news that they'll be closing their decades-old Chinese restaurant, the siblings soon find themselves reevaluating their futures.

programme.title: Christmas Town
programme.desc: Lauren leaves everything behind in Boston to embark on a new chapter in her life and career. On an unforeseen detour to the town of Grandon Falls, she discovers love and family, helping her to embrace the magic of Christmas.

programme.title: Heart of the Holidays
programme.desc: Career-driven Sam returns to her hometown for the holidays, where she comes face-to-face with her high school boyfriend, Noah. Together, they rediscover what matters most in life.

programme.title: A Very Merry Bridesmaid
programme.desc: Leah's 30th birthday is on Christmas Eve, the same day as her brother's wedding. Her childhood crush is back in town for the ceremony, and he's determined to make sure her special day doesn't go by the wayside.

programme.title: Christmas in Montana
programme.desc: Before the holidays, Sara, an efficiency expert, goes to Montana and attempts to help a man save his ranch.

programme.title: Debbie Macomber's Dashing Through the Snow
programme.desc: A young woman becomes stranded in an airport at Christmastime and accepts a ride from a man who rented the last rental car in town. As they head north, a hint of romance develops when they encounter a few bumps on the road.

programme.title: Christmas Tree Lane
programme.desc: When music store owner Meg spearheads community efforts to save her street from demolition, she is shocked to find out that the man she's falling for is working for the company that she is fighting.

programme.title: Christmas Under the Stars
programme.desc: Nick loses his high finance job right before Christmas. Lost, he takes a gig at a tree lot, where he meets Julie and her son, Matt.

programme.title: 'Tis the Season for Setups
programme.desc: When organized caterer Lexi and chill snowboarder Ridge notice a spark between their single parents, they begrudgingly team up to set them up.

programme.title: Our Holiday Story
programme.desc: A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.

programme.title: Holiday Hearts
programme.desc: While planning an annual Christmas party, Peyton is forced together with Ben to care for a friend's daughter.

programme.title: Round and Round
programme.desc: Rachel's stuck in a time loop, reliving the night of her parents' Hanukkah party. Can Zach, the nice boy grandma's trying to set her up with, help her make it to tomorrow?

programme.title: The Snow Must Go On

programme.title: The Housemaid
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start, a young woman becomes a live-in maid for a wealthy couple who harbor sinister secrets.

programme.title: Saltburn
programme.desc: A student is invited to an eccentric classmate's estate for an exciting summer.

programme.title: The Insurrectionist Next Door

programme.title: The Batman
programme.desc: Batman ventures into Gotham City's underworld when a sadistic killer leaves behind a trail of cryptic clues. As the scale of the perpetrator's plans become clear, he must bring justice to the abuse of power and corruption that plagues the metropolis.

programme.title: The Dark Knight
programme.desc: Batman must keep a balance between heroism and vigilantism to fight a criminal known as the Joker, who would plunge Gotham City into anarchy.

programme.title: The Dark Knight Rises
programme.desc: Eight years after he took the blame for Harvey Dent's death and vanished into the night, Batman is forced out of his self-imposed exile by a cunning cat burglar and a merciless terrorist called Bane.

programme.title: Superman
programme.desc: Tech billionaire Lex Luthor seizes the opportunity to get the Man of Steel out of the way for good. Will intrepid reporter Lois Lane and Superman's four-legged companion, Krypto, be able to help him before it's too late?

programme.title: Supergirl
programme.desc: Kara (Helen Slater) of Argo City poses as Clark Kent's cousin, Linda Lee, to recover the Omegahedron from a witch (Faye Dunaway).

programme.desc: U.S. government policies and westward expansion lead to tragic consequences for American Indians.

programme.desc: U.S. government policies and westward expansion lead to tragic consequences for American Indians.

programme.title: The Unbreakable Tatiana Suarez

programme.title: A Girl in the River: The Price of Forgiveness
programme.desc: A woman in Pakistan sentenced to death for falling in love becomes a rare survivor of the country's harsh judicial system.

programme.title: Plastic Disasters

programme.title: Saving Face
programme.desc: Plastic surgeon Dr. Mohammad Jawad returns to his native Pakistan to help those left horribly scarred by acid attacks.

programme.title: Coraline
programme.desc: A girl finds a secret door in her new home and walks into an alternate reality that closely mirrors her own but, in many ways, is better.

programme.title: ParaNorman
programme.desc: A ghoul-whispering youngster (Kodi Smit-McPhee) battles zombies, ghosts, witches and ignorant adults to save his town from an ancient curse.

programme.title: Kubo and the Two Strings
programme.desc: Young Kubo leads a quiet life in a small village until a spirit from the past renews an age-old vendetta, plunging him into a search for his father's magical armor to survive.

programme.title: The Boxtrolls
programme.desc: A boy (Isaac Hempstead-Wright) and his new friend (Elle Fanning) hatch a plan to save a community of mischievous cavern-dwellers from the villainous townsman (Ben Kingsley) who plans to exterminate them.

programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key
programme.desc: Parapsychologist Elise Rainier and her team travel to Five Keys, N.M., to investigate a claim of a haunting in her childhood home. She must soon confront and destroy her greatest fear, the demon that she accidentally set free years earlier.

programme.title: Insidious: The Red Door
programme.desc: Josh Lambert heads east to drop his son, Dalton, off at school. However, Dalton's college dream soon becomes a living nightmare when the repressed demons of his past suddenly return to haunt them both.

programme.title: The Conjuring: Last Rites
programme.desc: In 1986 paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren travel to Pennsylvania to vanquish a demon from a family's home.

programme.title: Backrooms
programme.desc: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom, leading to an endless network of interconnected rooms where time bends and the only thing scarier than getting lost is the sense that something is lying in wait.

programme.title: Undertone
programme.desc: The host of a popular paranormal podcast is sent hidden messages within anonymous recordings, unleashing a demonic presence that is impossible to escape.

programme.title: Ready Player One
programme.desc: In 2045, the creator of a virtual reality universe promises his fortune to the first person to discover a digital Easter egg. Soon, young Wade Watts finds himself in a reality-bending treasure hunt through the mysterious and fantastical world.

programme.title: The Drama
programme.desc: An explosive confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can truly make it to "I do."

programme.title: The Drama
programme.desc: An explosive confession throws the wedding of a seemingly perfect couple off the rails as they spiral to confront whether they can truly make it to "I do."

programme.title: Enigma
programme.desc: An exploration of transgender identity and legacy through the stories of icons April Ashley and Amanda Lear.

programme.title: The Legend of the Underground
programme.desc: Uncovering discrimination in Nigeria and exploring the lives of several charismatic, non-conformist youth who must choose either to fight for freedom of expression or flee to live free. Through social media, they spark a cultural revolution.

programme.title: The Out List
programme.desc: People from the LGBTQ community discuss being "out" in America; interviews include Neil Patrick Harris, Ellen DeGeneres, Christine Quinn, Cynthia Nixon, Wade Davis and Wanda Sykes.

programme.title: Knock Knock
programme.desc: Two nubile, stranded women reveal a sinister agenda after they spend the night with a married architect.

programme.title: Tusk
programme.desc: A U.S. podcaster (Justin Long) ventures into the Canadian wilderness to interview an old man (Michael Parks) who has an extraordinary past, and the American learns the man has a dark secret involving a walrus.

programme.title: Blumhouse's Truth or Dare
programme.desc: A game of truth or dare results in fatalities when an unknown entity penalizes participants for lying or declining challenges.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.

programme.title: Thanksgiving
programme.desc: A mysterious masked maniac terrorizes residents of Plymouth, Mass., one year after a Black Friday riot ended in tragedy. Picking off victims one by one, the seemingly random revenge killings soon become part of a larger, sinister plan.

programme.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
programme.desc: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

programme.title: The Long Walk
programme.desc: Teens participate in a grueling high-stakes contest where they must continuously walk or be shot by a member of their military escort.

programme.title: Hereditary
programme.desc: When the matriarch of the Graham family passes away, her daughter and grandchildren begin to unravel cryptic and increasingly terrifying secrets about their ancestry, trying to outrun the sinister fate they have inherited.

programme.title: The Hole in the Ground
programme.desc: One night, Sarah's young son disappears into the woods behind their rural home. When he returns, he looks the same, but his behavior grows increasingly disturbing. Sarah begins to believe that the boy who returned may not be her son at all.

programme.title: Talk to Me
programme.desc: When a group of friends discover how to conjure spirits with an embalmed hand, they become hooked on the new thrill and high-stakes party game -- until one of them goes too far and unleashes terrifying supernatural forces.

programme.title: X
programme.desc: A group of actors sets out to make an adult film in rural Texas under the noses of their reclusive hosts, but when the elderly couple catches their young guests in the act, the cast finds themselves in a desperate fight for their lives.

programme.title: Cinéma
programme.desc: Le 31 juillet 1914, Jean Jaurès, pacifiste convaincu, fervent opposant à la guerre, leader incontesté de la gauche et défenseur des ouvriers, est assassiné. Sa mort intervient trois jours avant l'entrée de la France dans la Première Guerre mondiale.

programme.title: La fabuleuse histoire de l'argent
programme.desc: De la Grèce antique à l'Amérique contemporaine en passant par la Chine ancienne et la Révolution française, cette série documentaire décrypte la place qu'elle a jouée depuis des millénaires.

programme.title: Les sanctuaires de la nature

programme.title: Jour d'audience
programme.desc: Marina Boulanger accuse son ex-petit ami, Anthony Mercier, d'avoir mis à son insu des images intimes d'elle sur Internet. Anthony nie les accusations, car, dit-il, son téléphone avait été volé.

programme.title: Loup, où es-tu?
programme.desc: Le loup est-il de retour dans les Hauts-de-France ? Dans ce documentaire exceptionnel, nous partons sur les traces de l'animal mythique disparu depuis plusieurs siècles dans les forêts de la région.

programme.title: Far West, l'histoire oubliée
programme.desc: À l'heure où un mur s'élève entre les États-Unis et le Mexique, un photographe retrace une autre frontière, celle d'avant 1848 et l'annexion de ces territoires mexicains; il révèle des souvenirs refoulés et des histoires personnelles fascinantes.

programme.title: La vie au temps des..

programme.title: Fiesta! Le sens de la fête

programme.title: La vie d'en haut
programme.desc: Dans les Pyrénées, une bergère audacieuse et une ourse secrète partagent la même montagne.

programme.title: Snowman race : une course pour le climat
programme.desc: En octobre 2024, le Royaume du Bhoutan a accueilli un ultramarathon exténuant en très haute altitude dans l'Himalaya. Cette course visait à attirer l'attention du monde sur la crise désormais qualifiée d'ébullition mondiale.

programme.title: Western: colts, torgnolles et haricots
programme.desc: Le mythe du cowboy est né dans les studios américains, mais quand on dit western, un nom revient sans cesse : celui de Sergio Leone, grand architecte du western dit spaghetti, car produit en Italie. Ce genre a permis l'émergence de nouveaux talents.

programme.title: La fabuleuse histoire de l'argent

programme.title: Sexe et amour au Brésil
programme.desc: Au Brésil, la séduction est un art de vivre; ici, la drague est directe, les femmes prennent l'initiative et les relations sans lendemain sont monnaie courante; dans les soirées électriques de Rio, on flirte sans tabou, porté par le culte du corps.

programme.title: La grande prairie, le pacte du bison

programme.title: Immersion sauvage - Yvan dans l'Ouest américain
programme.desc: Partez pour un voyage au coeur de l'Ouest américain, terre emblématique, mais menacée, abritant des espèces telles que les mustangs, les coyotes et les pygargues à tête blanche.

programme.title: Tenerife : l'île volcanique au climat doux toute l'année

programme.title: Rosa Bonheur, Dame nature
